dry_run.description: If true, show what would be updated without actually modifying the file

filepath.description: Path to the Altium library file (.PcbLib or .SchLib)

operation.description: The batch operation to perform. PcbLib: update_track_width, rename_layer. SchLib: update_parameters.

add_if_missing.description: For update_parameters: add parameter if not present (default: false)

from_layer.description: For rename_layer: source layer (e.g., Mechanical 1, Top Assembly)

from_width.description: For update_track_width: the track width to match (in mm)

param_name.description: For update_parameters: parameter name to update (e.g., 'Value')

param_value.description: For update_parameters: new value for the parameter

symbol_filter.description: For update_parameters: regex pattern to filter symbol names (optional)

to_layer.description: For rename_layer: target layer (e.g., Mechanical 2, Top Courtyard)

to_width.description: For update_track_width: the new track width (in mm)
